claim: Run the frozen three-arm local-formula pilot on 12 baryonic-feature-diverse SPARC exploration galaxies. A pilot result is a search diagnostic, not a universal gravity law.

pilot_selection.standardization: subtract the exploration-population median and divide by 1.4826 times median absolute deviation; use population standard deviation only for a zero-MAD feature
pilot_selection.selection: select the point farthest from the standardized origin, then repeatedly select the point maximizing its minimum squared Euclidean distance to a selected point; break exact ties by lexicographically greatest galaxy name
pilot_selection.note: The source packet has no audited morphology labels. This is baryonic-feature diversity, not a claim of formal morphology stratification.

local_constants.name: A
local_constants.fit: weighted least squares in squared velocity on the complementary training radii of each contiguous fold

arms.schedule: enumerate all coefficients in {-1,0,1} before the coefficient shell {-2,-1,0,1,2}; exclude duplicates from the inner shell

arms.grammar: the G0 rational grammar with at least one coefficient equal to -3 or 3, making it disjoint from structured_occam
arms.schedule: cycle-walked SplitMix Feistel pseudorandom chunk permutation with contiguous GPU inner ordinals
cycle-walked SplitMix Feistel pseudorandom chunk permutation over family and coefficient ordinals
arms.compiler_note: The LLM's raw shells multiplied a fitted acceleration by a0 and were dimensionally invalid as written. Only their dimensionless basis ideas were retained inside the frozen typed shell. This repair is compiler-authored and does not upgrade the LLM origin claim.

retained_but_not_compiled_in_v1.reason: covered by the wider rational control grammar and retained for G2 known-rewrite comparison
requires a separately benchmarked GPU special-function evaluator
requires a separately declared change-point grammar and smoothness policy
its stated asymptotic direction conflicts with the requested high-acceleration recovery; retained as a negative-control branch

admission.scope: each contiguous radial fold and aggregate out-of-fold predictions
must_not_exceed: nfw_halo_ceiling chi-square plus 2 times held-out row count

pilot_decision.pass: all 12 pilot galaxies have at least one CPU-FP64-admitted formula and each arm completed 10 million distinct within-trial candidates per galaxy
pilot_decision.block: any galaxy remains uncovered, an arm under-runs its budget, a candidate cannot replay, or a confirmation access occurs
pilot_decision.after_pass: scale the same frozen pilot grammar to all 139 exploration galaxies
pilot_decision.after_block: retain the complete failure ledger and broaden or repair G1; do not advance to G2
